title: Seek procedure run
statement: Let $h$ be a bit string, let $v$ assign a natural number to each of nine registers, and let $\mathrm{mode}$ and $\mathrm{suffix}$ be Boolean parameters. Suppose every register value is at most $4|h|+4$, register $2$ (if $\mathrm{suffix}$ is true) or register $5$ (otherwise) equals register $0$ plus $(2$ if true, $4$ otherwise$)\,\mathrm{count}$, register $7+\mathrm{count}\le 4|h|+4$, and register $7\le$ register $6$. If register $6<$ register $7+\mathrm{count}$, the machine reaches the hit state with register $0$ increased by $(2$ if $\mathrm{suffix}$ is true, $4$ otherwise$)(\text{register }6-\text{register }7)$ and register $7$ set to register $6$. Otherwise it reaches the answer-false state when $\mathrm{suffix}$ is true, or the clear-pointer stage $4$ when it is false; in either case register $0$ becomes the initial value of register $2$ or $5$, respectively, and register $7$ becomes its initial value plus $\mathrm{count}$. In both cases the result register remains unset, and throughout the run every intermediate configuration before the final one satisfies the machine's safety condition and has all register values at most $4|h|+4$.

Initial register assignment v on nine registers
Every register value is at most 4|h|+4
Register 2 or 5 equals register 0 plus the specified multiple of count
Register 7 plus count is at most 4|h|+4
